title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven: 17 Steps to Power
summary: Opening with the exciting news that Metro Manila is transitioning to General Community Quarantine (GCQ), President Hughes concludes his review of Grant Von Harrison's book. He highlights scriptural examples of trials preceding success—such as the sons of Mosiah and Wilford Woodruff—and warns missionaries about discerning between a trial of faith and a 'stupor of thought.' Finally, he summarizes the sequential 17 key steps to obtaining power from heaven, focusing heavily on written goals, alignment with God's will, and active faith.
